lessons.title: Axes, baselines, and honest scales
lessons.hook: A headline says 'Sales doubled' — but the chart tells a different story.

sections.title: Truncated axes
sections.slideNotes: Show paired charts with full vs truncated Y-axis; ask learners to spot the delta.

sections.title: Chart autopsy
sections.slideNotes: Small groups label what is measured, by whom, and what is missing.

sections.title: Quick poll
sections.slideNotes: Which revision is more honest? A/B screenshot comparison.

lessons.title: Peer feedback on executive summaries
lessons.hook: Executives read the first paragraph — everything else is optional.

sections.title: BLUF structure
sections.slideNotes: Bottom line up front; one claim, three proofs, explicit ask.

sections.title: Two-pass review
sections.slideNotes: Pass 1: clarity; Pass 2: evidence and tone.

sections.title: Exit ticket
sections.slideNotes: Rewrite one sentence to BLUF; share in thread.
